contest.description: The simple control contest and occupation (0064): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

contestPermille.description: Control the stronger side gains a day at an overwhelming margin, permille, times its margin. A design parameter.

occupyFullMen.description: The men at which occupation reaches its full rate; fewer gain in proportion. A design parameter.

occupyPermille.description: Control a side alone in held ground gains a day at full strength, permille. A design parameter.

latency.description: How long each route takes beside the map’s courier days (0026, 0032): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

courierNoiseMaxDays.description: The most extra days a courier or the mail can lose to roads and weather. A design parameter.

mailPermille.description: The mail against a courier, permille (slower: above 1000). A design parameter.

specialMessengerPermille.description: A special messenger against a courier, permille (faster: at most 1000). A design parameter.

specialMessengerPrice.description: The attention a special messenger costs its sender. A design parameter.

wireDays.description: Days for a message on the wire between two wired regions. A design parameter.

movement.description: Movement and messages over the graph (0064): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

courierPermille.description: A courier’s days on an edge, permille of a division’s, rounded up, at least one day. A design parameter.

marchMinCapacityPermille.description: The least capacity an edge needs this month to carry a march, permille of one unit of the capacity scale; at most capacityMax x 1000. A design parameter.

reportTemplates.description: One template for every report type and subtype the kernel writes (0032: each a pack-tunable template), with the pruning rule for knowledge (FOUNDATION section 8): design parameters the pack states.

cadenceDays.description: Every this many days, for a report written on a cycle; 0 for one written on an event. A design parameter.

keepSupersededDays.description: A report superseded by a newer one with the same template, author and subject is pruned once this old; at most maxAgeDays. A design parameter.

maxAgeDays.description: A held report older than this is pruned. A design parameter.

templateRoute.description: The usual route; an author off the wire falls back to courier.

templateSubtype.description: The subtype for the informal and advice families; null for every other type.

ruleSeats.description: The generic rule-seat principal (0064): its standing goals stay at hold until its faction is at war, which a situation flag the pack names marks.

warFlags.description: One row per faction in the manifest.

flag.description: The situation chain flag that puts this faction at war; null for war from day 1.

standing.description: The stand-in standing goals (0040, 0072): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

conflictWindowDays.description: Days within which a chain order stands against a newer order that went around the chain (0040). A design parameter.

scoreCap.description: The highest score a standing-goal menu gives an advance, permille of his demand, so an empty region does not dwarf every other term. A design parameter.

stores.description: Stores on hand (0040, 0064): design parameters the pack states, not sourced facts.

capDays.description: The most days of stores a block refills to. A design parameter.

lowDays.description: Stores below this many days are low, a truth event a report may tell; at most capDays. A design parameter.

menPerCapacityUnit.description: Men (and non-combatants) one unit of the capacity scale feeds for a day. A design parameter.

government.description: A civil government that can hold a region’s jurisdiction (0058): only such a department may be named in a scenario’s governments. The engine reads this, never kind names.

selfGoverning.description: A government of a people who govern themselves (0069): only its own act, a notice, may change its side, close or reopen it, or move its regions, never a principal’s decision. Only a government may be self-governing.

role.description: What the engine reads of this kind (0058): filter (holds or passes what comes in for its principal) or intelligence; null for any other kind. The engine never reads kind names.
